name: Star Chroma
author: toasty-wheeler
description: Razer Chroma lighting for Starsector. Campaign: ability keys 1-0 glow light blue when ready and red while in use or cooling down; Tab, E, C, D, F, R, I, F2 (codex), F4 and F5 (quicksave/quickload) glow light blue. Combat: everything goes white, shields fill blue from the bottom up, flux heats the lights to red-orange, hull damage makes keys flicker, glitch and die, ship systems (F) get their own effects (burn streaks, teleport collapse and burst, phase shimmer, ammo-feed belts), and losing your flagship sets off an explosion. Needs Razer Synapse / Razer Chroma app running. Safe to add or remove at any time.
